clue.text: Topless dress is to be sent back to Italy, madam

indicators.note: sending something back returns it the way it came, so these letters are read in the opposite order
a garment without its top loses the first letter of the word

parts.note: a sarong is a wrapped dress from South-East Asia

explanation.surface: Someone told that a revealing dress must be returned to Italy, addressed politely as madam.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Topless' takes the S off SARONG, leaving ARONG; with IS that gives ARONGIS, which 'to be sent back' turns into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian form of address for a married woman, the counterpart of the English courtesy title.

clue.text: Celebrity can get doctor round in time for birth

parts.note: a celebrity is a star
a can is a tin
GP, general practitioner, is a family doctor
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A famous person summons a doctor just in time for a baby's delivery.
explanation.definitionFit: Birth figuratively is the origin or beginning of something, where it all started.

clue.text: Rugged Derek called over

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned over means the letters run the other way

parts.note: Del is a short form of the name Derek
rang means telephoned, called

explanation.surface: A rough-looking man named Derek has telephoned again.
explanation.definitionFit: Both describe something rough, knotty and weathered in texture, like old wood or hands.

clue.text: Ruminants' stomachs like a second going over

indicators.note: going over signals that the letters are turned upside down in this down entry

parts.note: as means like, in the manner of
a mo is a moment, a second

explanation.surface: Cows' stomachs examined again for a brief moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural of the Latin anatomical term for the third chamber of a cow's stomach, the psalterium.

clue.text: Classical elegance consumed endlessly, thus it elevated millions

indicators.note: without its end, the word loses its final letter

parts.note: ate means consumed

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised up means the letters are read upwards

parts.note: sic is Latin for thus
M is the abbreviation for million

explanation.surface: Refined classical style was absorbed endlessly, and so it lifted millions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'elevated' turns SICIT into TICIS, set between AT and M.
explanation.definitionFit: The term names the refined, pure style of ancient Athens and Attic Greek writing.

clue.text: Writer's skill showcased in series regularly

indicators.note: something showcased is set within a display, so one piece sits inside the other
taking letters at regular intervals, the first, third and fifth

parts.note: art means skill

explanation.surface: An author's talent is displayed throughout a series of books.
explanation.definitionFit: Jean-Paul Sartre was the French existentialist novelist, playwright and philosopher.

clue.text: Most confident squirrel oddly finds a way

indicators.note: oddly picks the odd-numbered letters of the word

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: The most self-assured squirrel strangely finds its route.
explanation.definitionFit: Superlative of a word meaning certain or assured, so most certain.

clue.text: Concerned with heads of Dorking hens exposed as foxes appear

parts.note: re means concerning, with regard to

indicators.note: the heads of words are their first letters

parts.note: aired means exposed, brought into the open

explanation.surface: Chickens in Dorking are worried as foxes appear near the henhouse.
explanation.walkthrough: Dorking is a town in Surrey, and also a breed of chicken.
explanation.definitionFit: Foxes have russet, ginger coats, so they look this colour.

clue.text: A collection of cattle made into mince that's no good

indicators.note: no good means the letter for good is removed

parts.note: minced meat has been ground up

explanation.surface: A herd of cows turned into mince, which is no good for them.
explanation.definitionFit: The gathering together of cattle by cowboys on a ranch for counting or branding.

clue.text: What's used for carving in the manner of turkey roaster

parts.note: a la is French for in the style of
a baster is used to moisten a roasting turkey; also one who bastes it

explanation.surface: Something used in carving, like a person roasting a Christmas turkey.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft white stone that sculptors carve into ornaments and statues.

clue.text: Suspect Democrat known to have pocketed billions

indicators.note: pocketing something puts it inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: out means known, revealed
B is the abbreviation for billion

explanation.surface: An American politician is suspected of having embezzled billions.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to suspect is to distrust or question something.

clue.text: Interest in people that have not gone off the rails

definitions.text: Interest in people that have not gone off the rails

parts.words: Interest in people that have not gone off the rails
parts.note: seems to mean concern for well-behaved people, but is the hobby of noting railway engines still on their tracks

explanation.surface: A sociologist's study of people who stayed on the straight and narrow.
explanation.definitionFit: The hobby of watching locomotives and recording their numbers, which literally stay on the rails.

clue.text: City that's beginning to get large in America

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter
one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: USA is America

explanation.surface: A city that is starting to grow big in the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: Tulsa is a city in Oklahoma, in the United States.

clue.text: Conservative fool with artillery is one anticipating disaster

parts.note: an ass is a fool
and means with, together with
RA is the Royal Artillery

explanation.surface: A Tory idiot with heavy guns is expecting catastrophe.
explanation.definitionFit: The Trojan prophetess of Greek myth foretold doom but was never believed; now any pessimistic forecaster.

clue.text: Lumpy, old and mostly uninteresting in smell

indicators.note: the old and dull pieces go inside the smell word

parts.note: to nose is to smell, sniff

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: dull means uninteresting

explanation.surface: Something knobbly, aged and rather boring that smells.
explanation.definitionFit: A technical term for having small nodules or knobs, so knobbly.

clue.text: Lake above country house is effective at a distance

parts.note: on means on top of, above
a grange is a country house with farm buildings

explanation.surface: A lake sits above a manor house in the country.
explanation.definitionFit: Describes weapons or forecasts able to reach or cover far-off targets.

clue.text: Showing cheek put back with a new cut through bone

indicators.note: put back means the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: pert means cheeky, impudent

explanation.surface: A cheeky surgeon is sent back to perform a fresh operation on the skull.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to bore a hole in the skull with a surgical saw.

clue.text: Star of a Roman Catholic channel backed America

indicators.note: backed means the letters are turned round

parts.note: a rut is a groove or channel
US is America

explanation.surface: A celebrity from a Catholic television channel supported the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: Arcturus is the brightest star in the constellation Boötes.

clue.text: Seeming not to have used any precautions initially? That's me

indicators.note: something not used is left out, so those letters are removed

parts.note: apparent means seeming

indicators.note: initially picks the first letters of the words

explanation.surface: Someone who didn't take precautions admits the consequence: a baby, and now they are responsible.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition comes from the speaker: someone who skipped precautions is now a mother or father.
explanation.definitionFit: The speaker identifies as a mother or father, the natural result of not using contraception.

clue.text: Turner is rubbish at men

parts.note: rot means rubbish, nonsense
OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers, men

explanation.surface: The painter Turner is hopeless with people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turner' looks like the painter, but is something that turns.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that rotates, such as a muscle or a machine part, is a thing that turns.

clue.text: Call for rapid movement over deficit

indicators.note: turned over means the letters are reversed

parts.note: to page is to call someone
a dart is a quick, sudden movement

explanation.surface: A demand for quick action to cover a shortfall.
explanation.definitionFit: The shortfall when a country's imports exceed its exports in value.

clue.text: Italian playwright's work put on in centre of Cagliari

parts.note: go means work, function

indicators.note: the put-on word goes inside the centre letters
the centre of the eight-letter word is its two middle letters

parts.note: to don is to put on clothes

explanation.surface: An Italian dramatist's play staged in the middle of Cagliari, a Sardinian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Carlo Goldoni was an eighteenth-century Venetian comic dramatist.

clue.text: Apple with fungal disease mostly covering batch

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece sits on top of the other
mostly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: rust is a fungal disease of plants
a set is a batch or group

explanation.surface: An apple variety with blight affecting most of a batch.
explanation.definitionFit: A variety of eating apple with a rough, brownish skin.

clue.text: Break put to rest game point

parts.note: to inter is to bury, put to rest
RU is rugby union, a game

explanation.surface: A pause to rest the game at a certain point.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to break in on someone is to cut them off mid-speech.

clue.text: University gets involved in rating your health

indicators.note: something involved in is placed inside, so one piece enters the other

parts.note: a rating is an ordinary sailor, an old salt

explanation.surface: A university assesses your health status.
explanation.definitionFit: The French toast, said when raising a glass to someone's wellbeing.

clue.text: Polynesian group dance British made into disc

indicators.note: one letter is turned into another

parts.note: the samba is a Brazilian dance
O is disc-shaped

explanation.surface: A British dance band pressed onto a record in the Pacific.
explanation.definitionFit: An island group in the South Pacific, part of Polynesia.

clue.text: Magnetic attraction revealed in bronze colossus

indicators.note: something revealed in a thing appears within it, so one piece sits inside

parts.note: tan is a bronze colour from the sun
it means sex appeal, magnetic charm

explanation.surface: Magnetic pull is shown in a huge bronze statue, like the Colossus of Rhodes.
explanation.definitionFit: A giant of Greek myth, and so any person or thing of great size.

clue.text: Volcano — one to throw up a lot of extra tons with sulphur about

indicators.note: about means the whole string is turned round

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
to lob is to throw upwards

indicators.note: a lot of a word is most of it, losing the last letter

parts.note: more means extra
S is the chemical symbol for sulphur

explanation.surface: A volcano erupting and hurling up many tons of sulphur.
explanation.definitionFit: Stromboli is an active volcanic island off Sicily.

clue.text: Seize time for relaxation after a run

indicators.note: after means this piece comes behind the others

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run
rest is time for relaxation

explanation.surface: A jogger takes a break after a run.
explanation.definitionFit: To apprehend or take someone into custody, as the police do.

clue.text: Flying high is frightening with little oxygen where it's cold

indicators.note: with one letter where the other was signals replacement

parts.note: scaring means frightening
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: Flying at altitude is scary, with thin air where the temperature drops.
explanation.definitionFit: Rising or gliding up high in the air, as a bird or plane does.
